canonicalIngredients.name: canned tomatoes
observations: 28 oz can whole, hand-crushed, with juice (s0)
28 oz can whole peeled San Marzano (s2)

causalSequence: heat olive oil over medium-low; soften whole/minced garlic gently, never browned
add chilli flakes; bloom briefly in the oil
add canned tomatoes with juice, crush roughly; season salt; simmer 20-30 min until thickened
stir parsley (or basil) through off heat
boil penne in salted water to 1-2 min short of al dente
transfer pasta into sauce with a splash of starchy pasta water; toss over medium heat 1-2 min to finish
serve; grated cheese optional garnish only
techniqueFacts: all four sources bloom garlic + chilli flakes in olive oil before tomatoes, garlic kept from browning
simmer time is the main variance: 5-10 min (s1), 20-25 min (s0), 25-30 min (s2)
two sources (s0, s2) finish pasta in the sauce with reserved starchy water, cooking it 1-2 min under al dente first

sauce itself is dairy-free in every source; parmesan/pecorino appears only as a finishing garnish - optional (s0), listed topping (s1), omitted with dish called vegan (s2), vegan parmesan (s3) - so the vegan cell holds if cheese is omitted or vegan; s1-as-written is vegetarian not vegan
herb split: parsley (s0, s2) vs basil (s1, s3), always added at the end
s3 is a variant: adds vegan Italian sausage and pickled pepperoncini + brine; not canonical
s1 alone adds tomato paste; s2 notes passata as an accepted tomato substitute
s2 and s3 state the dish is naturally vegan/dairy-free; Roman origin, heat level meant to be adjustable via flake quantity
